```javascript
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { api } from '../utils/api';
import { getSession, setSession, clearSession, getRefreshToken } from '../utils/session';
import { API_BASE } from '../utils/config';

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export const useAuth = () => {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth must be used inside AuthProvider');
  return ctx;
};

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const logout = useCallback(() => {
    // Revoke the refresh token server-side (best-effort, fire-and-forget)
    // so the stored session can't be replayed after sign-out.
    const refreshToken = getRefreshToken();
    clearSession();
    setUser(null);
    if (refreshToken) {
      fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/logout`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: refreshToken }),
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, []);

  const verifySession = useCallback(async () => {
    const session = getSession();
    if (!session?.access_token) {
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    // The session itself lives in localStorage; /auth/me only confirms it's
    // still valid server-side. A network failure (backend restarting, flaky
    // connection) must NEVER clear it — a user who signed in once stays
    // signed in until the refresh token truly expires or is revoked.
    try {
      const me = await api.get('/auth/me');
      setUser(me);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.status === 401) {
        // Real auth failure — refresh already failed inside api.js.
        logout();
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
    }

    // Network error — backend may just be starting up. Retry once before
    // giving up; the cached session stays signed in either way.
    console.warn('AuthProvider: backend unreachable during session check — retrying once');
    setTimeout(() => {
      api
        .get('/auth/me')
        .then((me) => setUser(me))
        .catch((err) => {
          if (err.status === 401) logout();
          // Still unreachable — remain signed in on the cached session.
        })
        .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }, 2000);
  }, [logout]);

  useEffect(() => {
    verifySession();

    const onUnauthorized = () => logout();
    window.addEventListener('auth:unauthorized', onUnauthorized);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('auth:unauthorized', onUnauthorized);
  }, [verifySession, logout]);

  const login = useCallback(async (...args) => {
    // Support both call styles: login(username, password) and login({ username, password })
    let uname;
    let pwd;
    if (args.length === 1 && typeof args[0] === 'object') {
      const obj = args[0] || {};
      uname = obj.username;
      pwd = obj.password;
    } else {
      uname = args[0];
      pwd = args[1];
    }

    const res = await api.post('/auth/login', { username: uname, password: pwd });
    console.info('AuthProvider: login response', res);
    setSession({
      access_token: res.access_token,
      refresh_token: res.refresh_token, // rotated opaque refresh token
    });
    const me = await api.get('/auth/me');
    console.info('AuthProvider: fetched /auth/me after login', me);
    setUser(me);
    return me;
  }, []);

  const register = useCallback(async (a, b, c, d) => {
    // Support register(username, email, password, full_name)
    // and register({ username, email, password, full_name })
    let payload;
    if (typeof a === 'object') {
      payload = a || {};
    } else {
      payload = { username: a, email: b, password: c, full_name: d };
    }

    const res = await api.post('/auth/register', payload);
    setSession({
      access_token: res.access_token,
      refresh_token: res.refresh_token,
    });
    const me = await api.get('/auth/me');
    setUser(me);
    return me;
  }, []);

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        loading,
        isAuthenticated: !!user,
        login,
        logout,
        register,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "./AuthContext";
import api from "../utils/api";

/**
 * Owns everything the conversation-history UI needs: the sidebar list, the
 * currently active LangGraph thread, and the restored message transcript.
 *
 * The backend is the single source of truth — the list is fetched from
 * /agent/threads and a thread's messages from /agent/threads/{id}; we keep
 * no separate local store. State is shared here (via the context) so
 * Sidebar and ChatWindow stay in sync without prop drilling.
 */
const ConversationsContext = createContext(null);

export function ConversationsProvider({ children }) {
  const { user, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const patientId = user?.id || user?.username || "guest";

  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState([]);
  // Starts true: the provider remounts on every sign-in (keyed by user id in
  // App.jsx), so the sidebar shows its skeleton until the first fetch lands.
  const [listLoading, setListLoading] = useState(true);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  // A brand-new chat gets a fresh UUID thread id; selecting an existing
  // conversation replaces it with that conversation's thread id.
  const [activeThreadId, setActiveThreadId] = useState(() => crypto.randomUUID());
  // Which sidebar row is highlighted. null for a brand-new chat that has not
  // been persisted yet (there is no row for it).
  const [selectedThreadId, setSelectedThreadId] = useState(null);

  const busy = historyLoading || sending;

  // Load the sidebar list when a patient signs in. The whole provider is
  // keyed by user id in App.jsx, so a sign-out / sign-in as another patient
  // remounts it and all state here starts fresh — no reset needed in this
  // effect (which would cause a synchronous render loop).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) return;

    let cancelled = false;
    api
      .get("/agent/threads")
      .then((list) => {
        if (!cancelled) setConversations(list);
      })
      .catch((err) => console.error("Failed to load conversations:", err))
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setListLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [patientId, isAuthenticated]);

  /** Refresh the sidebar list (after a send, so timestamps/new threads show). */
  const refreshList = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) return;
    try {
      const list = await api.get("/agent/threads");
      setConversations(list);
      setSelectedThreadId((prev) => {
        // Highlight the thread we're actively chatting in once it persists.
        if (list.some((c) => c.thread_id === activeThreadId)) return activeThreadId;
        return list.some((c) => c.thread_id === prev) ? prev : null;
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to refresh conversations:", err);
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated, activeThreadId]);

  /** Start a fresh conversation: new thread id, empty window. */
  const newChat = useCallback(() => {
    const threadId = crypto.randomUUID();
    setActiveThreadId(threadId);
    setSelectedThreadId(null);
    setMessages([]);
  }, []);

  /** Resume an existing conversation from its checkpoints. */
  const selectConversation = useCallback(async (threadId) => {
    setSelectedThreadId(threadId);
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    try {
      const detail = await api.get(`/agent/threads/${threadId}`);
      setActiveThreadId(detail.thread_id);
      setMessages(detail.messages || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to load conversation:", err);
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <ConversationsContext.Provider
      value={{
        patientId,
        conversations,
        listLoading,
        historyLoading,
        sending,
        setSending,
        busy,
        messages,
        activeThreadId,
        selectedThreadId,
        setMessages,
        setSelectedThreadId,
        newChat,
        selectConversation,
        refreshList,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </ConversationsContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useConversations() {
  const ctx = useContext(ConversationsContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useConversations must be used within a ConversationsProvider");
  return ctx;
}
```

```javascript
import { API_BASE } from './config';
import { authFetch, getAccessToken } from './session';

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(message, status) {
    super(message);
    this.status = status;
  }
}

async function request(path, options = {}) {
  // authFetch handles proactive refresh, 401 refresh-and-retry, and
  // session cleanup + auth:unauthorized dispatch when refresh fails.
  let res;
  try {
    res = await authFetch(path, options);
  } catch (err) {
    // authFetch throws exactly two kinds: real auth failure (session dead)
    // and network failure (server unreachable). Only the first may look
    // like a 401 — a network blip must never be treated as "signed out".
    if (err?.isAuthFailure) throw new ApiError('Unauthorized', 401);
    throw new ApiError(err?.message || 'Network error', 0);
  }

  if (res.status === 401) {
    throw new ApiError('Unauthorized', 401);
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text();
    throw new ApiError(text || `HTTP ${res.status}`, res.status);
  }

  if (res.status === 204) return null;
  return res.json();
}

export const api = {
  get: (path) => request(path, { method: 'GET' }),
  post: (path, body) => request(path, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
  put: (path, body) => request(path, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
  patch: (path, body) => request(path, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
  del: (path) => request(path, { method: 'DELETE' }),
};

// Helpers for streaming endpoints (ChatWindow, etc.)
export const getStreamUrl = (path) => `${API_BASE}${path}`;

export const getAuthHeaders = () => {
  const token = getAccessToken();
  return token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};
};

export async function fetchPatientMemories(patientId) {
  return api.get(`/memory/patient/${patientId}`);
}

export async function updatePatientMemory(patientId, memoryId, updateData) {
  return api.patch(`/memory/patient/${patientId}/${memoryId}`, updateData);
}

// Backwards-compat default export for existing imports
export default api;
```

## File: `frontend\src\utils\image.js`

```javascript
/**
 * Image → base64 helper for the agent's OCR input.
 *
 * The agent endpoint accepts `image_base64` as a raw base64 string
 * (`app/core/rag/ocr.py` does a bare `base64.b64decode`), so the
 * `data:image/...;base64,` prefix from `readAsDataURL` must be stripped.
 * Large images are downscaled on a canvas so the JSON payload stays small,
 * while small images are kept at full resolution (higher detail helps OCR).
 */

const MAX_DIMENSION = 2048;
const MAX_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024; // 2 MB

function readAsDataURL(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
    reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error || new Error("Failed to read file"));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

/**
 * Downscale an image file on a canvas, returning a compressed data URL.
 * Falls back to the original data URL if canvas processing fails.
 */
function downscale(dataUrl, maxDim) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      try {
        const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(img.width, img.height));
        if (scale >= 1) return resolve(dataUrl); // already small enough

        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.width = Math.round(img.width * scale);
        canvas.height = Math.round(img.height * scale);
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        resolve(canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.85));
      } catch {
        resolve(dataUrl);
      }
    };
    img.onerror = () => resolve(dataUrl);
    img.src = dataUrl;
  });
}

/**
 * Read an image file into { base64, dataUrl, name }.
 *
 * @param {File} file
 * @param {Object} [opts]        - { maxDim, maxBytes }
 * @returns {Promise<{base64: string, dataUrl: string, name: string}>}
 */
export async function fileToImageData(file, opts = {}) {
  const maxDim = opts.maxDim ?? MAX_DIMENSION;
  const maxBytes = opts.maxBytes ?? MAX_BYTES;

  let dataUrl = await readAsDataURL(file);

  // Downscale only genuinely large images (payload bound); keep small
  // images untouched so OCR gets maximum resolution.
  if (file.size > maxBytes) {
    dataUrl = await downscale(dataUrl, maxDim);
  }

  // Strip the `data:image/<type>;base64,` prefix → raw base64 for the backend.
  const commaIdx = dataUrl.indexOf(",");
  const base64 = commaIdx >= 0 ? dataUrl.slice(commaIdx + 1) : dataUrl;

  return { base64, dataUrl, name: file.name };
}
```

```javascript
// src/utils/session.js

import { API_BASE } from './config';

const SESSION_KEY = 'health_companion_session';
const TOKEN_EXPIRY_KEY = 'health_companion_token_expiry';

// Default token expiry time (in minutes) — should match backend ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES
const ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 60;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Error kinds — callers MUST distinguish these:
//   NetworkError     → server unreachable; the stored session may still be
//                      perfectly valid and must NEVER be cleared.
//   UnauthorizedError→ auth genuinely failed (refresh dead/revoked); the
//                      session was already cleared when this is thrown.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export class NetworkError extends Error {
  constructor(message = 'Cannot reach the server — check your connection.') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'NetworkError';
    this.isNetworkError = true;
  }
}

export class UnauthorizedError extends Error {
  constructor(message = 'Unauthorized') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'UnauthorizedError';
    this.isAuthFailure = true;
  }
}

export const getSession = () => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const setSession = (session) => {
  localStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(session));
  // When tokens are issued, record the current time so we can calculate expiry
  recordTokenIssuedTime();
};

export const clearSession = () => {
  localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_EXPIRY_KEY);
};

export const getAccessToken = () => getSession()?.access_token ?? null;
export const getRefreshToken = () => getSession()?.refresh_token ?? null;

/**
 * Record the time tokens were issued (now).
 * Used for proactive refresh — we calculate expiry as issuedTime + ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES.
 */
export const recordTokenIssuedTime = () => {
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_EXPIRY_KEY, JSON.stringify({
    issued_at: Date.now(),
    expires_in_ms: ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES * 60 * 1000,
  }));
};

/**
 * Get the expiry time for the current access token (milliseconds since epoch).
 * Returns null if tokens haven't been issued yet.
 */
export const getTokenExpiryTime = () => {
  try {
    const data = localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_EXPIRY_KEY);
    if (!data) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
    return parsed.issued_at + parsed.expires_in_ms;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

/**
 * Check if the access token is expiring soon (within threshold minutes).
 * Returns true if token is within `thresholdMinutes` of expiry.
 * @param thresholdMinutes - How many minutes before expiry to consider it "soon" (default 2)
 */
export const isTokenExpiringSoon = (thresholdMinutes = 2) => {
  const expiryTime = getTokenExpiryTime();
  if (!expiryTime) return false;
  
  const now = Date.now();
  const expiryThreshold = thresholdMinutes * 60 * 1000;
  
  return expiryTime - now < expiryThreshold;
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Refresh interceptor
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const onUnauthorized = () => {
  clearSession();
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('auth:unauthorized'));
};

/**
 * Exchange the refresh token for a new access + refresh pair.
 * Implements token rotation: the old refresh token is revoked server-side.
 * Throws on failure (session is cleared and auth:unauthorized is dispatched).
 */
async function refreshAccessToken() {
  const refreshToken = getRefreshToken();
  if (!refreshToken) {
    onUnauthorized();
    throw new UnauthorizedError('No refresh token available');
  }

  let res;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/refresh`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: refreshToken }),
    });
  } catch {
    // Backend unreachable. The refresh token may still be valid — never
    // clear the session over a transport failure.
    throw new NetworkError();
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    onUnauthorized();
    throw new UnauthorizedError(`Token refresh failed (HTTP ${res.status})`);
  }

  const data = await res.json();
  setSession({
    access_token: data.access_token,
    refresh_token: data.refresh_token,
  });
  return data.access_token;
}

// Single-flight: concurrent callers share one in-flight refresh promise
let refreshInFlight = null;

/**
 * Refresh the access token. If a refresh is already in progress, wait for it
 * instead of issuing a parallel request (prevents refresh-token rotation races).
 */
export function refreshSession() {
  if (!refreshInFlight) {
    refreshInFlight = refreshAccessToken().finally(() => {
      refreshInFlight = null;
    });
  }
  return refreshInFlight;
}

/**
 * Proactively refresh the token if it's expiring soon.
 * Call before making important requests. Fire-and-forget safe:
 * returns false instead of throwing when no refresh is needed/possible.
 */
export async function ensureFreshToken() {
  if (!getAccessToken() || !isTokenExpiringSoon()) return false;
  try {
    await refreshSession();
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Proactive refresh failed, will retry on 401:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Authenticated fetch with refresh interception.
 * - Proactively refreshes before the request if the token is near expiry
 * - On a 401 response, refreshes once and retries the original request
 */
export async function authFetch(path, options = {}) {
  await ensureFreshToken();

  const doFetch = async () => {
    const token = getAccessToken();
    return fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
      ...options,
      headers: {
        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
        ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
        ...options.headers,
      },
    });
  };

  let res;
  try {
    res = await doFetch();
  } catch {
    // Transport failure (backend down / offline / CORS) — NOT an auth
    // failure. Leave the stored session untouched.
    throw new NetworkError();
  }

  if (res.status === 401) {
    try {
      await refreshSession();
    } catch (err) {
      // Refresh either genuinely failed (session already cleared) or the
      // server was unreachable mid-refresh. Propagate the right kind so
      // callers don't log users out over a network blip.
      throw err instanceof NetworkError ? err : new UnauthorizedError();
    }
    try {
      res = await doFetch(); // retry exactly once with the new token
    } catch {
      throw new NetworkError();
    }
  }

  return res;
}
```

## File: `frontend\src\utils\time.js`

```javascript
/**
 * Tiny timestamp helpers for the sidebar.
 */

/**
 * "just now" / "5m ago" / "3h ago" / "2d ago" / "Aug 4" for an ISO string.
 * Returns "" for missing or unparseable input.
 */
export function formatRelativeTime(iso) {
  if (!iso) return "";
  const then = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(then.getTime())) return "";

  const seconds = Math.round((Date.now() - then.getTime()) / 1000);
  if (seconds < 60) return "just now";
  if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.round(seconds / 60)}m ago`;
  if (seconds < 86400) return `${Math.round(seconds / 3600)}h ago`;
  const days = Math.round(seconds / 86400);
  if (days < 7) return `${days}d ago`;

  return then.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}
```

```
    "import re\n",

    "words = ' '.join(df['input'].dropna()).lower()\n",
    "words = re.sub(r'[^a-z ]','', words).split()\n",

    "freq = Counter(w for w in words if w not in stopwords\n",
    "               and len(w)>3)\n",
    "print(freq.most_common(20))"

    "import os\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "datasets = [\n",
    "    'chatdoctor.csv',\n",
    "    'medqa.csv',\n",
    "    'medmcqa.csv',\n",
    "    'meddialog.csv',\n",
    "    'icliniq.csv',\n",
    "    'pubmedqa.csv',\n",
    "    'disease_symptoms.csv'\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 45)\n",
    "print(\"   DATASET DOWNLOAD CHECKPOINT\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 45)\n",
    "\n",
    "total = 0\n",
    "for name in datasets:\n",
    "    path = f'data/raw/{name}'\n",
    "    if os.path.exists(path):\n",
    "        df = pd.read_csv(path)\n",
    "        print(f\"✅ {name:<30} {len(df):>7,} samples\")\n",
    "        total += len(df)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        print(f\"❌ {name:<30} MISSING\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 45)\n",
    "print(f\"   TOTAL: {total:,} samples\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 45)"
   ]
  }
```

```
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import ast\n",
    "\n",
    "# Load MedQA\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv('data/raw/medqa.csv')\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Total samples: {len(df)}\")\n",
    "print(df.head(2))"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "code",

   "id": "1093f413",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Converting MedQA to instruction format...\n",
      "  Processed 0/11451 rows...\n",
      "  Processed 2000/11451 rows...\n",
      "  Processed 4000/11451 rows...\n",
      "  Processed 6000/11451 rows...\n",
      "  Processed 8000/11451 rows...\n",
      "  Processed 10000/11451 rows...\n",
      "\n",
      "✅ Converted: 11451 samples\n",
      "❌ Failed:    0 samples\n",
      "\n",
      "Sample output:\n",
      "==================================================\n",
      "Clinical Case:\n",
      "A 23-year-old pregnant woman at 22 weeks gestation presents with burning upon urination. She states it started 1 day ago and has been worsening despite drinking more water and taking cranberry extract. She otherwise feels well and is followed by a doctor for her pregnancy. Her tempera\n",
      "---\n",
      "Based on the clinical presentation, I will analyze this case step by step.\n",
      "\n",
      "Looking at the key findings in this case and evaluating each option carefully, the correct answer is D) Nitrofurantoin.\n",
      "\n",
      "Clinical Reasoning:\n",
      "This answer is correct because the clinical features presented align with Nitrofura\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Fixed instruction — same for all MedQA samples\n",
    "INSTRUCTION = \"\"\"You are an expert medical AI assistant and health companion. \n",
    "You help patients and medical professionals by analyzing clinical cases, \n",
    "reasoning through symptoms and findings, and providing accurate diagnoses \n",
    "with clear explanations. Always explain your reasoning step by step.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "def convert_medqa_row(row):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Convert one MedQA row to instruction format\n",
    "    with reasoning chain in output\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        # Parse options — stored as string dict\n",
    "        # Looks like: {'A': 'Ampicillin', 'B': 'Ceftriaxone'...}\n",
    "        if isinstance(row['options'], str):\n",
    "            options = ast.literal_eval(row['options'])\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            options = row['options']\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Build options text\n",
    "        options_text = \"\\n\".join([\n",
    "            f\"{key}) {value}\" \n",
    "            for key, value in options.items()\n",
    "        ])\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Build the INPUT — clinical case + options\n",
    "        input_text = f\"\"\"Clinical Case:\n",
    "{row['question']}\n",
    "\n",
    "Options:\n",
    "{options_text}\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Build the OUTPUT — reasoning + answer\n",
    "        correct_answer = str(row['answer']).strip()\n",
    "        answer_idx = str(row['answer_idx']).strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "        output_text = f\"\"\"Based on the clinical presentation, I will analyze this case step by step.\n",
    "\n",
    "Looking at the key findings in this case and evaluating each option carefully, the correct answer is {answer_idx}) {correct_answer}.\n",
    "\n",
    "Clinical Reasoning:\n",
    "This answer is correct because the clinical features presented align with {correct_answer}. The patient's presentation, history, and findings are most consistent with this diagnosis/treatment choice. The other options are less appropriate given the specific clinical context described.\n",
    "\n",
    "Diagnosis/Answer: {correct_answer}\n",
    "Confidence: High\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            'instruction': INSTRUCTION,\n",
    "            'input': input_text,\n",
    "            'output': output_text\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Apply conversion to all rows\n",
    "print(\"Converting MedQA to instruction format...\")\n",
    "converted = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, row in df.iterrows():\n",
    "    result = convert_medqa_row(row)\n",
    "    if result is not None:\n",
    "        converted.append(result)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Progress update every 2000 rows\n",
    "    if idx % 2000 == 0:\n",
    "        print(f\"  Processed {idx}/{len(df)} rows...\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save converted dataset\n",
    "df_converted = pd.DataFrame(converted)\n",
    "df_converted.to_csv(\n",
    "    'data/cleaned/medqa_instruction.csv', \n",
    "    index=False\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Converted: {len(df_converted)} samples\")\n",
    "print(f\"❌ Failed:    {len(df) - len(df_converted)} samples\")\n",
    "print(f\"\\nSample output:\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 50)\n",
    "print(df_converted.iloc[0]['input'][:300])\n",
    "print(\"---\")\n",
    "print(df_converted.iloc[0]['output'][:300])"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv('data/raw/medmcqa.csv')\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Total samples: {len(df)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Map index number to correct option text\n",
    "OPTION_MAP = {0: 'opa', 1: 'opb', 2: 'opc', 3: 'opd'}\n",
    "OPTION_LABEL = {0: 'A', 1: 'B', 2: 'C', 3: 'D'}\n",
    "\n",
    "INSTRUCTION = \"\"\"You are an empathetic AI health companion and medical assistant. \n",
    "You help patients by carefully listening to their symptoms, asking relevant follow-up \n",
    "questions when needed, providing a possible diagnosis with reasoning, and recommending \n",
    "holistic treatment including medicines, diet, exercise, and natural remedies. \n",
    "Always respond in a warm, caring, and supportive tone.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "def convert_medmcqa_row(row):\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        # Get all options safely\n",
    "        opa = str(row['opa']).strip() if pd.notna(row['opa']) else \"N/A\"\n",
    "        opb = str(row['opb']).strip() if pd.notna(row['opb']) else \"N/A\"\n",
    "        opc = str(row['opc']).strip() if pd.notna(row['opc']) else \"N/A\"\n",
    "        opd = str(row['opd']).strip() if pd.notna(row['opd']) else \"N/A\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Get correct answer using cop index\n",
    "        cop = int(row['cop'])\n",
    "        correct_col = OPTION_MAP.get(cop, 'opa')\n",
    "        correct_label = OPTION_LABEL.get(cop, 'A')\n",
    "        correct_answer = str(row[correct_col]).strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Get explanation if available\n",
    "        has_exp = pd.notna(row['exp']) and len(str(row['exp'])) > 10\n",
    "        explanation = str(row['exp']).strip() if has_exp else \"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Get subject for context\n",
    "        subject = str(row['subject_name']).strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Build INPUT\n",
    "        input_text = f\"\"\"Medical Question ({subject}):\n",
    "{str(row['question']).strip()}\n",
    "\n",
    "Options:\n",
    "A) {opa}\n",
    "B) {opb}\n",
    "C) {opc}\n",
    "D) {opd}\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Build OUTPUT with or without explanation\n",
    "        if has_exp:\n",
    "            output_text = f\"\"\"The correct answer is {correct_label}) {correct_answer}.\n",
    "\n",
    "Clinical Reasoning:\n",
    "{explanation}\n",
    "\n",
    "Summary: Based on medical knowledge in {subject}, \n",
    "the answer is {correct_answer}. This is important \n",
    "for understanding disease mechanisms and treatment \n",
    "in clinical practice.\n",
    "Confidence: High\"\"\"\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            output_text = f\"\"\"The correct answer is {correct_label}) {correct_answer}.\n",
    "\n",
    "Clinical Reasoning:\n",
    "Based on established medical knowledge in {subject}, \n",
    "{correct_answer} is the correct answer to this question. \n",
    "This concept is fundamental to understanding clinical \n",
    "medicine and patient care.\n",
    "Confidence: High\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            'instruction': INSTRUCTION,\n",
    "            'input': input_text,\n",
    "            'output': output_text\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Convert all rows\n",
    "print(\"Converting MedMCQA to instruction format...\")\n",
    "converted = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, row in df.iterrows():\n",
    "    result = convert_medmcqa_row(row)\n",
    "    if result is not None:\n",
    "        converted.append(result)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if idx % 20000 == 0:\n",
    "        print(f\"  Processed {idx:,}/{len(df):,} rows...\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save\n",
    "df_converted = pd.DataFrame(converted)\n",
    "df_converted.to_csv(\n",
    "    'data/cleaned/medmcqa_instruction.csv',\n",
    "    index=False\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Converted:  {len(df_converted):,} samples\")\n",
    "print(f\"❌ Failed:     {len(df) - len(df_converted):,} samples\")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv('data/raw/meddialog.csv')\n",
    "print(f\"Total samples: {len(df)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "INSTRUCTION = \"\"\"You are an empathetic AI health companion and medical assistant. \n",
    "You help patients by carefully listening to their symptoms, asking relevant follow-up \n",
    "questions when needed, providing a possible diagnosis with reasoning, and recommending \n",
    "holistic treatment including medicines, diet, exercise, and natural remedies. \n",
    "Always respond in a warm, caring, and supportive tone.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "def convert_meddialog_row(row):\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        dialogue = str(row['dialogue']).strip()\n",
    "        soap = str(row['soap']).strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Skip if too short\n",
    "        if len(dialogue) < 50 or len(soap) < 50:\n",
    "            return None\n",
    "\n",
    "        # INPUT → the full doctor-patient dialogue\n",
    "        input_text = f\"\"\"The following is a real doctor-patient consultation dialogue. \n",
    "Analyze the conversation, understand the patient's complaints, \n",
    "and provide a structured medical assessment:\n",
    "\n",
    "{dialogue}\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        # OUTPUT → SOAP summary = perfect structured output\n",
    "        output_text = f\"\"\"Based on the patient consultation, here is the complete medical assessment:\n",
    "\n",
    "{soap}\n",
    "\n",
    "This assessment covers the patient's subjective complaints, objective findings, \n",
    "clinical diagnosis, and the recommended treatment plan to address their health concerns.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            'instruction': INSTRUCTION,\n",
    "            'input': input_text,\n",
    "            'output': output_text\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Convert\n",
    "print(\"Converting MedDialog to instruction format...\")\n",
    "converted = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, row in df.iterrows():\n",
    "    result = convert_meddialog_row(row)\n",
    "    if result is not None:\n",
    "        converted.append(result)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save\n",
    "df_converted = pd.DataFrame(converted)\n",
    "df_converted.to_csv(\n",
    "    'data/cleaned/meddialog_instruction.csv',\n",
    "    index=False\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Converted:  {len(df_converted):,} samples\")\n",
    "print(f\"❌ Skipped:    {len(df) - len(df_converted):,} samples\")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv('data/raw/icliniq.csv')\n",
    "print(f\"Total questions: {len(df)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "INSTRUCTION = \"\"\"You are an empathetic AI health companion and medical assistant. \n",
    "You help patients by carefully listening to their symptoms, asking relevant follow-up \n",
    "questions when needed, providing a possible diagnosis with reasoning, and recommending \n",
    "holistic treatment including medicines, diet, exercise, and natural remedies. \n",
    "Always respond in a warm, caring, and supportive tone.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# Phrases that make an answer useless for training\n",
    "GARBAGE_PHRASES = [\n",
    "    \"as an ai language model\",\n",
    "    \"i am an ai\",\n",
    "    \"i'm an ai\",\n",
    "    \"i cannot provide medical advice\",\n",
    "    \"please consult a doctor\",\n",
    "    \"i am not a doctor\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "def is_good_answer(text, min_length=150):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Check if answer is worth keeping\"\"\"\n",
    "    if pd.isna(text):\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    text_lower = str(text).lower()\n",
    "    if len(text_lower) < min_length:\n",
    "        return False\n",
    "    for phrase in GARBAGE_PHRASES:\n",
    "        if phrase in text_lower:\n",
    "            return False\n",
    "    return True\n",
    "\n",
    "def make_sample(input_text, answer_text):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Build one instruction format sample\"\"\"\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        'instruction': INSTRUCTION,\n",
    "        'input': str(input_text).strip(),\n",
    "        'output': str(answer_text).strip()\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Convert — create up to 3 samples per question\n",
    "print(\"Converting iCliniq to instruction format...\")\n",
    "converted = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, row in df.iterrows():\n",
    "    input_text = str(row['input']).strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Skip bad inputs\n",
    "    if len(input_text) < 20:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Answer 1 — Real iCliniq doctor (always try first)\n",
    "    if is_good_answer(row['answer_icliniq'], min_length=100):\n",
    "        converted.append(\n",
    "            make_sample(input_text, row['answer_icliniq'])\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Answer 2 — ChatGPT (stricter filter)\n",
    "    if is_good_answer(row['answer_chatgpt'], min_length=200):\n",
    "        converted.append(\n",
    "            make_sample(input_text, row['answer_chatgpt'])\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Answer 3 — ChatDoctor\n",
    "    if is_good_answer(row['answer_chatdoctor'], min_length=150):\n",
    "        converted.append(\n",
    "            make_sample(input_text, row['answer_chatdoctor'])\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save\n",
    "df_converted = pd.DataFrame(converted)\n",
    "df_converted.to_csv(\n",
    "    'data/cleaned/icliniq_instruction.csv',\n",
    "    index=False\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Original questions:  {len(df):,}\")\n",
    "print(f\"✅ Total samples made:  {len(df_converted):,}\")\n",
    "print(f\"📈 Multiplication:      {len(df_converted)/len(df):.1f}x\")"
   ]
  },

    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import ast\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv('data/raw/pubmedqa.csv')\n",
    "print(f\"Total samples: {len(df)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"\\nDecision distribution:\")\n",
    "print(df['final_decision'].value_counts())\n",
    "\n",
    "INSTRUCTION = \"\"\"You are an empathetic AI health companion and medical assistant. \n",
    "You help patients by carefully listening to their symptoms, asking relevant follow-up \n",
    "questions when needed, providing a possible diagnosis with reasoning, and recommending \n",
    "holistic treatment including medicines, diet, exercise, and natural remedies. \n",
    "Always respond in a warm, caring, and supportive tone.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# Map final decision to confidence language\n",
    "DECISION_MAP = {\n",
    "    'yes':   ('Yes', 'High',   'The evidence strongly supports this conclusion.'),\n",
    "    'no':    ('No',  'High',   'The evidence clearly does not support this.'),\n",
    "    'maybe': ('Uncertain', 'Low', 'The evidence is mixed and inconclusive.')\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "def extract_context(context_str):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Extract clean text from context dictionary string\"\"\"\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        context_dict = ast.literal_eval(str(context_str))\n",
    "        contexts = context_dict.get('contexts', [])\n",
    "        # Join all context paragraphs into one clean text\n",
    "        return ' '.join([str(c).strip() for c in contexts])\n",
    "    except:\n",
    "        return str(context_str).strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "def convert_pubmedqa_row(row):\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        question = str(row['question']).strip()\n",
    "        long_answer = str(row['long_answer']).strip()\n",
    "        decision = str(row['final_decision']).strip().lower()\n",
    "        context_text = extract_context(row['context'])\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Skip if any field is too short\n",
    "        if len(question) < 10 or len(long_answer) < 20:\n",
    "            return None\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Get decision language\n",
    "        decision_word, confidence, evidence_stmt = \\\n",
    "            DECISION_MAP.get(decision, \n",
    "                ('Uncertain', 'Low', 'Evidence is limited.'))\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Build INPUT — question + research context\n",
    "        input_text = f\"\"\"Medical Research Question:\n",
    "{question}\n",
    "\n",
    "Research Context:\n",
    "{context_text[:800]}\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Build OUTPUT — evidence based answer with reasoning\n",
    "        output_text = f\"\"\"Based on the available medical research and evidence:\n",
    "\n",
    "Answer: {decision_word}\n",
    "\n",
    "Research Findings:\n",
    "{long_answer}\n",
    "\n",
    "Evidence Assessment:\n",
    "{evidence_stmt}\n",
    "\n",
    "Confidence Level: {confidence}\n",
    "\n",
    "Clinical Implication:\n",
    "This research finding is relevant for clinical \n",
    "decision-making. Healthcare providers should consider \n",
    "this evidence alongside individual patient factors, \n",
    "medical history, and clinical judgment when making \n",
    "treatment decisions.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        return {\n",
    "            'instruction': INSTRUCTION,\n",
    "            'input': input_text,\n",
    "            'output': output_text\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        return None\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Convert all rows\n",
    "print(\"\\nConverting PubMedQA to instruction format...\")\n",
    "converted = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, row in df.iterrows():\n",
    "    result = convert_pubmedqa_row(row)\n",
    "    if result is not None:\n",
    "        converted.append(result)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save\n",
    "df_converted = pd.DataFrame(converted)\n",
    "df_converted.to_csv(\n",
    "    'data/cleaned/pubmedqa_instruction.csv',\n",
    "    index=False\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Converted:  {len(df_converted):,} samples\")\n",
    "print(f\"❌ Skipped:    {len(df) - len(df_converted):,} samples\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Show decision distribution in converted data\n",
    "print(f\"\\nDecision coverage:\")\n",
    "print(df['final_decision'].value_counts())"
   ]
  },

    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv('data/raw/disease_symptoms.csv')\n",
    "print(f\"Total diseases: {len(df)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "INSTRUCTION = \"\"\"You are an empathetic AI health companion and medical assistant. \n",
    "You help patients by carefully listening to their symptoms, asking relevant follow-up \n",
    "questions when needed, providing a possible diagnosis with reasoning, and recommending \n",
    "holistic treatment including medicines, diet, exercise, and natural remedies. \n",
    "Always respond in a warm, caring, and supportive tone.\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "def convert_disease_row(row):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Generate 4 sample types from one disease row\"\"\"\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        disease = str(row['Name']).strip()\n",
    "        symptoms = str(row['Symptoms']).strip()\n",
    "        treatments = str(row['Treatments']).strip() \\\n",
    "            if pd.notna(row['Treatments']) else \"Consult a doctor\"\n",
    "\n",
    "        samples = []\n",
    "\n",
    "        # --- Type 1 --- Symptoms → Diagnosis\n",
    "        samples.append({\n",
    "            'instruction': INSTRUCTION,\n",
    "            'input': f\"\"\"I have been experiencing the following symptoms:\n",
    "{symptoms}\n",
    "\n",
    "Based on these symptoms, what condition might I have \n",
    "and what should I do?\"\"\",\n",
    "            'output': f\"\"\"Based on the symptoms you have described, this presentation \n",
    "is consistent with {disease}.\n",
    "\n",
    "Symptoms Associated with {disease}:\n",
    "{symptoms}\n",
    "\n",
    "Recommended Treatment Approach:\n",
    "{treatments}\n",
    "\n",
    "Important: Please consult a qualified healthcare \n",
    "professional for proper diagnosis and personalized \n",
    "treatment. This information is for educational \n",
    "purposes and should not replace medical consultation.\n",
    "Confidence: Moderate\"\"\"\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "        # --- Type 2 --- Disease → What are symptoms?\n",
    "        samples.append({\n",
    "            'instruction': INSTRUCTION,\n",
    "            'input': f\"\"\"Can you tell me what are the main symptoms \n",
    "of {disease}? I want to understand this condition better.\"\"\",\n",
    "            'output': f\"\"\"{disease} is a medical condition that presents \n",
    "with the following symptoms:\n",
    "\n",
    "{symptoms}\n",
    "\n",
    "These symptoms can vary in severity from person to person. \n",
    "Some individuals may experience all of these symptoms while \n",
    "others may only have a few. Early recognition of these \n",
    "symptoms is important for timely diagnosis and treatment.\n",
    "\n",
    "If you or someone you know is experiencing these symptoms, \n",
    "please seek medical attention promptly.\"\"\"\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "        # --- Type 3 --- Disease → What are treatments?\n",
    "        samples.append({\n",
    "            'instruction': INSTRUCTION,\n",
    "            'input': f\"\"\"I have been diagnosed with {disease}. \n",
    "What are the available treatment options and how \n",
    "can I manage this condition?\"\"\",\n",
    "            'output': f\"\"\"For {disease}, the following treatment \n",
    "options are available:\n",
    "\n",
    "{treatments}\n",
    "\n",
    "Treatment Guidance:\n",
    "The treatment approach depends on the severity of your \n",
    "condition, your overall health, and individual factors. \n",
    "Work closely with your healthcare provider to determine \n",
    "the most appropriate treatment plan for your situation.\n",
    "\n",
    "General Wellness Recommendations:\n",
    "Maintain a healthy lifestyle with balanced nutrition, \n",
    "regular appropriate exercise, adequate sleep, and stress \n",
    "management alongside your prescribed treatment.\"\"\"\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "        # --- Type 4 --- Full clinical scenario\n",
    "        samples.append({\n",
    "            'instruction': INSTRUCTION,\n",
    "            'input': f\"\"\"Patient presents with: {symptoms}\n",
    "\n",
    "Please provide a complete clinical assessment including \n",
    "diagnosis, explanation, and full treatment plan.\"\"\",\n",
    "            'output': f\"\"\"Complete Clinical Assessment:\n",
    "\n",
    "Diagnosis: {disease}\n",
    "Confidence: Moderate to High\n",
    "\n",
    "Presenting Symptoms:\n",
    "{symptoms}\n",
    "\n",
    "Clinical Explanation:\n",
    "The symptom combination presented is characteristic of \n",
    "{disease}. This condition requires proper medical \n",
    "evaluation and management.\n",
    "\n",
    "Recommended Treatment Plan:\n",
    "{treatments}\n",
    "\n",
    "Holistic Recommendations:\n",
    "In addition to medical treatment, focus on adequate \n",
    "rest, proper nutrition, hydration, and follow-up \n",
    "appointments with your healthcare provider. Monitor \n",
    "your symptoms and report any worsening to your doctor \n",
    "immediately.\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow-up: Schedule regular check-ups to monitor \n",
    "your progress and adjust treatment as needed.\"\"\"\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "        return samples\n",
    "\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        return []\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Convert all rows — generates 4 samples per disease\n",
    "print(\"Converting Disease-Symptoms to instruction format...\")\n",
    "converted = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, row in df.iterrows():\n",
    "    samples = convert_disease_row(row)\n",
    "    converted.extend(samples)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save\n",
    "df_converted = pd.DataFrame(converted)\n",
    "df_converted.to_csv(\n",
    "    'data/cleaned/disease_symptoms_instruction.csv',\n",
    "    index=False\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Original diseases:  {len(df):,}\")\n",
    "print(f\"✅ Total samples made: {len(df_converted):,}\")\n",
    "print(f\"📈 Multiplication:     {len(df_converted)/len(df):.1f}x\")"
   ]
```

```python
import pandas as pd

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION

RAW_FOLDER = "data/raw/"
OUTPUT_DIR = "data/final10"

TRAIN_FILE = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_FILE = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
FULL_FILE = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "full_dataset.csv")

RANDOM_STATE = 42

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# TARGET DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

# Original 10K training distribution
TRAIN_ALLOCATION = {
    "chatdoctor": 3500,
    "icliniq": 2000,
    "medmcqa": 1500,
    "medqa": 1000,
    "meddialog": 800,
    "disease_symptoms": 700,
    "pubmedqa": 500,
}

# 500 test samples with EXACTLY the same distribution
TEST_ALLOCATION = {
    "chatdoctor": 175,
    "icliniq": 100,
    "medmcqa": 75,
    "medqa": 50,
    "meddialog": 40,
    "disease_symptoms": 35,
    "pubmedqa": 25,
}

FILE_NAMES = [
    "chatdoctor.csv",
    "disease_symptoms.csv",
    "icliniq.csv",
    "meddialog.csv",
    "medmcqa.csv",
    "medqa.csv",
    "pubmedqa.csv",
]

# ============================================================
# MEDMCQA CONFIG
# ============================================================

OPTION_LABEL = {
    0: "A",
    1: "B",
    2: "C",
    3: "D",
}

# ============================================================
# STORAGE
# ============================================================

train_samples = []
test_samples = []

print("=" * 70)
print(" BUILDING 10K TRAIN + 500 TEST + 10.5K FULL DATASET")
print("=" * 70)


# ============================================================
# PROCESS EACH SOURCE
# ============================================================

for fname in FILE_NAMES:

    key = fname.replace(".csv", "")
    path = os.path.join(RAW_FOLDER, fname)

    train_n = TRAIN_ALLOCATION.get(key, 0)
    test_n = TEST_ALLOCATION.get(key, 0)

    # Total required from this source
    total_required = train_n + test_n

    print(f"\nProcessing: {key}")
    print(f"  Required train : {train_n:,}")
    print(f"  Required test  : {test_n:,}")
    print(f"  Required total : {total_required:,}")

    try:

        df = pd.read_csv(path)
        df = df.fillna("")

        samples = []

        # ====================================================
        # CHATDOCTOR
        # ====================================================

        if key == "chatdoctor":

            for _, row in df.iterrows():

                q = str(row.get("input", "")).strip()
                a = str(row.get("output", "")).strip()

                if len(q) > 20 and len(a) > 30:

                    samples.append({
                        "text": (
                            f"### Question:\n{q}\n\n"
                            f"### Answer:\n{a}"
                        ),
                        "source": key
                    })

        # ====================================================
        # ICLINIQ
        # ====================================================

        elif key == "icliniq":

            for _, row in df.iterrows():

                q = str(row.get("input", "")).strip()
                a = str(row.get("answer_icliniq", "")).strip()

                if len(q) > 20 and len(a) > 30:

                    samples.append({
                        "text": (
                            f"### Question:\n{q}\n\n"
                            f"### Answer:\n{a}"
                        ),
                        "source": key
                    })

        # ====================================================
        # MEDMCQA
        # ====================================================

        elif key == "medmcqa":

            for _, row in df.iterrows():

                try:

                    cop = int(row.get("cop", 0))

                    opts = {
                        "A": str(row.get("opa", "")),
                        "B": str(row.get("opb", "")),
                        "C": str(row.get("opc", "")),
                        "D": str(row.get("opd", "")),
                    }

                    correct_label = OPTION_LABEL.get(cop, "A")
                    correct_answer = opts[correct_label]

                    exp = str(row.get("exp", "")).strip()
                    subject = str(row.get("subject_name", "")).strip()

                    opts_text = "\n".join(
                        f"{k}) {v}"
                        for k, v in opts.items()
                        if v.strip()
                    )

                    q = (
                        f"[{subject}]\n"
                        f"{str(row.get('question', '')).strip()}\n\n"
                        f"Options:\n{opts_text}"
                    )

                    a = (
                        f"The correct answer is "
                        f"{correct_label}) {correct_answer}."
                    )

                    if exp and len(exp) > 10:
                        a += f"\n\nExplanation: {exp}"

                    if len(q) > 20 and len(a) > 10:

                        samples.append({
                            "text": (
                                f"### Question:\n{q}\n\n"
                                f"### Answer:\n{a}"
                            ),
                            "source": key
                        })

                except Exception:
                    continue

        # ====================================================
        # MEDQA
        # ====================================================

        elif key == "medqa":

            for _, row in df.iterrows():

                try:

                    opts = row.get("options", {})

                    if isinstance(opts, str):
                        opts = ast.literal_eval(opts)

                    opts_text = "\n".join(
                        f"{k}) {v}"
                        for k, v in opts.items()
                    )

                    q = (
                        f"{str(row.get('question', '')).strip()}"
                        f"\n\nOptions:\n{opts_text}"
                    )

                    answer = str(row.get("answer", "")).strip()
                    idx = str(row.get("answer_idx", "")).strip()

                    a = f"The correct answer is {idx}) {answer}."

                    if len(q) > 20 and len(a) > 10:

                        samples.append({
                            "text": (
                                f"### Question:\n{q}\n\n"
                                f"### Answer:\n{a}"
                            ),
                            "source": key
                        })

                except Exception:
                    continue

        # ====================================================
        # MEDDIALOG
        # ====================================================

        elif key == "meddialog":

            for _, row in df.iterrows():

                dialogue = str(row.get("dialogue", "")).strip()
                soap = str(row.get("soap", "")).strip()

                if len(dialogue) > 50 and len(soap) > 50:

                    samples.append({
                        "text": (
                            f"### Question:\n"
                            f"Patient Consultation:\n"
                            f"{dialogue}\n\n"
                            f"### Answer:\n{soap}"
                        ),
                        "source": key
                    })

        # ====================================================
        # DISEASE SYMPTOMS
        # ====================================================

        elif key == "disease_symptoms":

            for _, row in df.iterrows():

                name = str(row.get("Name", "")).strip()
                symptoms = str(row.get("Symptoms", "")).strip()
                treats = str(row.get("Treatments", "")).strip()

                if name and symptoms:

                    # Type 1: Symptoms -> Diagnosis
                    samples.append({
                        "text": (
                            f"### Question:\n"
                            f"Patient has: {symptoms}\n"
                            f"What condition is this "
                            f"and how to treat it?\n\n"
                            f"### Answer:\n"
                            f"This presentation is consistent "
                            f"with {name}.\n"
                            f"Recommended treatment: {treats}"
                        ),
                        "source": key
                    })

                    # Type 2: Disease -> Symptoms + Treatment
                    samples.append({
                        "text": (
                            f"### Question:\n"
                            f"What are the symptoms and "
                            f"treatment for {name}?\n\n"
                            f"### Answer:\n"
                            f"Symptoms of {name}: {symptoms}\n"
                            f"Treatment: {treats}"
                        ),
                        "source": key
                    })

        # ====================================================
        # PUBMEDQA
        # ====================================================

        elif key == "pubmedqa":

            DECISION = {
                "yes": "Yes, the evidence supports this.",
                "no": "No, the evidence does not support this.",
                "maybe": "The evidence is inconclusive.",
            }

            for _, row in df.iterrows():

                q = str(row.get("question", "")).strip()
                answer = str(row.get("long_answer", "")).strip()
                decision = str(row.get("final_decision", "")).strip()

                ctx = row.get("context", "")

                ctx_text = ""

                if isinstance(ctx, str) and ctx.startswith("{"):

                    try:

                        ctx_dict = ast.literal_eval(ctx)

                        ctx_text = " ".join(
                            ctx_dict.get("contexts", [])
                        )[:400]

                    except Exception:
                        ctx_text = ""

                if len(q) > 10 and len(answer) > 20:

                    full_q = q

                    if ctx_text:
                        full_q += f"\n\nContext: {ctx_text}"

                    full_a = (
                        f"{DECISION.get(decision, '')}\n\n"
                        f"{answer}"
                    )

                    samples.append({
                        "text": (
                            f"### Question:\n{full_q}\n\n"
                            f"### Answer:\n{full_a}"
                        ),
                        "source": key
                    })

        # ====================================================
        # QUALITY FILTER
        # ====================================================

        samples = [
            x for x in samples
            if len(x["text"]) > 80
        ]

        df_source = pd.DataFrame(samples)

        available = len(df_source)

        print(f"  Valid samples   : {available:,}")

        # ====================================================
        # CHECK ENOUGH DATA
        # ====================================================

        if available < total_required:

            raise ValueError(
                f"{key} has only {available:,} valid samples, "
                f"but {total_required:,} are required."
            )

        # ====================================================
        # RANDOMLY SELECT TOTAL
        #
        # IMPORTANT:
        # We select train + test together first.
        # Then split them.
        #
        # This guarantees:
        # - NO train/test overlap
        # - same source distribution
        # - reproducibility
        # ====================================================

        df_selected = df_source.sample(
            n=total_required,
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE
        ).reset_index(drop=True)

        # Shuffle selected samples before split
        df_selected = df_selected.sample(
            frac=1,
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE
        ).reset_index(drop=True)

        # ====================================================
        # SPLIT SOURCE
        # ====================================================

        df_train = df_selected.iloc[:train_n].copy()

        df_test = df_selected.iloc[
            train_n:train_n + test_n
        ].copy()

        train_samples.append(df_train)
        test_samples.append(df_test)

        print(
            f"  ✅ Selected       : {len(df_selected):,}"
        )
        print(
            f"  ✅ Train          : {len(df_train):,}"
        )
        print(
            f"  ✅ Test           : {len(df_test):,}"
        )

    except FileNotFoundError:

        print(
            f"  ❌ FILE NOT FOUND: {path}"
        )

    except Exception as e:

        print(
            f"  ❌ ERROR: {e}"
        )


# ============================================================
# MERGE TRAIN
# ============================================================

df_train = pd.concat(
    train_samples,
    ignore_index=True
)

# Shuffle complete train dataset
df_train = df_train.sample(
    frac=1,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
).reset_index(drop=True)


# ============================================================
# MERGE TEST
# ============================================================

df_test = pd.concat(
    test_samples,
    ignore_index=True
)

# Shuffle complete test dataset
df_test = df_test.sample(
    frac=1,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
).reset_index(drop=True)


# ============================================================
# FULL DATASET
# ============================================================

df_full = pd.concat(
    [df_train, df_test],
    ignore_index=True
)

df_full = df_full.sample(
    frac=1,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
).reset_index(drop=True)


# ============================================================
# FINAL VALIDATION
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print(" FINAL VALIDATION")
print("=" * 70)

print(f"\nTrain samples : {len(df_train):,}")
print(f"Test samples  : {len(df_test):,}")
print(f"Full samples  : {len(df_full):,}")


# ============================================================
# ASSERT EXACT COUNTS
# ============================================================

assert len(df_train) == 10_000, (
    f"Expected 10,000 train samples, "
    f"got {len(df_train)}"
)

assert len(df_test) == 500, (
    f"Expected 500 test samples, "
    f"got {len(df_test)}"
)

assert len(df_full) == 10_500, (
    f"Expected 10,500 full samples, "
    f"got {len(df_full)}"
)

# ============================================================
# CHECK DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

print("\nTRAIN DISTRIBUTION")
print("-" * 50)

for source, expected in TRAIN_ALLOCATION.items():

    actual = int(
        (df_train["source"] == source).sum()
    )

    print(
        f"{source:<20} "
        f"{actual:>5,} / {expected:>5,}"
    )

    assert actual == expected


print("\nTEST DISTRIBUTION")
print("-" * 50)

for source, expected in TEST_ALLOCATION.items():

    actual = int(
        (df_test["source"] == source).sum()
    )

    print(
        f"{source:<20} "
        f"{actual:>5,} / {expected:>5,}"
    )

    assert actual == expected


# ============================================================
# CHECK TRAIN / TEST OVERLAP
# ============================================================

train_texts = set(df_train["text"])
test_texts = set(df_test["text"])

overlap = train_texts.intersection(test_texts)

print("\nTRAIN / TEST OVERLAP")
print("-" * 50)
print(f"Duplicate samples: {len(overlap):,}")

assert len(overlap) == 0, (
    "ERROR: Train/test leakage detected!"
)


# ============================================================
# CHECK FULL DATASET
# ============================================================

assert len(df_full) == (
    len(df_train) + len(df_test)
)

print("✅ No train/test overlap")
print("✅ Train distribution correct")
print("✅ Test distribution correct")
print("✅ Full dataset contains train + test")


# ============================================================
# SAVE FILES
# ============================================================

df_train[
    ["text", "source"]
].to_csv(
    TRAIN_FILE,
    index=False
)

df_test[
    ["text", "source"]
].to_csv(
    TEST_FILE,
    index=False
)

df_full[
    ["text", "source"]
].to_csv(
    FULL_FILE,
    index=False
)


# ============================================================
# FINAL REPORT
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print(" DATASETS SUCCESSFULLY CREATED")
print("=" * 70)

print(f"""
Train:
  File    : {TRAIN_FILE}
  Samples : {len(df_train):,}

Test:
  File    : {TEST_FILE}
  Samples : {len(df_test):,}

Full:
  File    : {FULL_FILE}
  Samples : {len(df_full):,}
""")

print("TRAIN SOURCE DISTRIBUTION")
print(df_train["source"].value_counts().sort_index())

print("\nTEST SOURCE DISTRIBUTION")
print(df_test["source"].value_counts().sort_index())

print("\nFULL SOURCE DISTRIBUTION")
print(df_full["source"].value_counts().sort_index())

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print(" ✅ DATASET READY FOR FINE-TUNING")
print("=" * 70)
```

```
    "CAPS = {\n",

    "    'MedQA':           11451,  # keep all\n",
    "    'MedMCQA':         30000,  # cap at 30k (was 182k)\n",
    "    'MedDialog':        9250,  # keep all\n",
    "    'iCliniq':         21000,  # keep all\n",

    "\n",
    "# Remove rows where input or output too short\n",
    "df_merged = df_merged[df_merged['input'].str.len() > 20]\n",
    "df_merged = df_merged[df_merged['output'].str.len() > 20]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove duplicates based on input\n",
    "df_merged = df_merged.drop_duplicates(subset=['input'])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Strip whitespace\n",
    "df_merged['input'] = df_merged['input'].str.strip()\n",
    "df_merged['output'] = df_merged['output'].str.strip()\n",
    "df_merged['instruction'] = df_merged['instruction'].str.strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "after = len(df_merged)\n",
    "print(f\"Before cleaning: {before:,}\")\n",
    "print(f\"After cleaning:  {after:,}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Removed:         {before - after:,} bad rows\")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "# 6.Shuffle the dataset"

   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "63625e3a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [

   "source": [
    "# ─────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "# Step 6 — Shuffle the dataset\n",
    "# ─────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "\n",
    "# CRITICAL STEP — Without shuffling:\n",
    "# Model sees all ChatDoctor first, then all MedQA...\n",
    "# It forgets early datasets by the time training ends\n",
    "# Shuffling ensures every batch has mixed dataset samples\n",
    "\n",
    "df_merged = df_merged.sample(\n",
    "    frac=1, random_state=42\n",
    ").reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Dataset shuffled successfully\")\n",
    "print(f\"Final shape: {df_merged.shape}\")"
   ]
```

```
    "## 📑 Table of Contents\n",

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## About Dataset\n",
    " 🩺 Multi-Source Medical Dataset for LLM Fine-Tuning (10.5K Samples)\n",
    "\n",
    "### Why this dataset exists\n",
    "Most medical LLM fine-tuning datasets rely on a **single source**, leading to \n",
    "narrow, biased models that overfit to one style of medical text (e.g., only \n",
    "patient chats, or only exam questions). This dataset solves that by **merging \n",
    "7 diverse, high-quality medical sources** into one clean, balanced, and \n",
    "deduplicated corpus — giving your model exposure to real patient dialogue, \n",
    "clinical Q&A, symptom-diagnosis pairs, and medical exam reasoning all in one \n",
    "place.\n",
    "\n",
    "### What's inside\n",
    "A carefully stratified split of **10,500 total samples** (10,000 train / 500 \n",
    "test), sampled proportionally from **7 established medical NLP datasets** to \n",
    "preserve real-world source diversity while keeping the dataset small enough \n",
    "for fast, affordable fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA-ready).\n",
    "\n",
    "| Source | Train | Test | Total | Description |\n",
    "|---|---|---|---|---|\n",
    "| **ChatDoctor** | 3,500 | 175 | 3,675 | Real patient-doctor chat conversations |\n",
    "| **iCliniq** | 2,000 | 100 | 2,100 | Online clinical consultation Q&A |\n",
    "| **MedMCQA** | 1,500 | 75 | 1,575 | Medical entrance exam MCQs |\n",
    "| **MedQA** | 1,000 | 50 | 1,050 | USMLE-style medical exam questions |\n",
    "| **MedDialog** | 800 | 40 | 840 | Doctor-patient dialogue dataset |\n",
    "| **Disease-Symptoms** | 700 | 35 | 735 | Structured symptom-to-diagnosis mapping |\n",
    "| **PubMedQA** | 500 | 25 | 525 | Biomedical research literature QA |\n",
    "\n",
    "### ✅ Quality guarantees\n",
    "- **Zero train/test overlap** — verified, no duplicate samples\n",
    "- **Proportional source distribution** maintained across train/test/full splits\n",
    "- **100% validated** sample selection (no missing/corrupt rows)\n",
    "- Ready-to-use `train.csv`, `test.csv`, and `full_dataset.csv`\n",

    "### Use cases\n",

    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def split_qa(text):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Split the raw text into (question, answer) using the ### markers.\"\"\"\n",
    "    q_match = re.search(r\"###\\s*Question:\\s*(.*?)\\s*###\\s*Answer:\", text, re.S)\n",
    "    a_match = re.search(r\"###\\s*Answer:\\s*(.*)\", text, re.S)\n",
    "    question = q_match.group(1).strip() if q_match else text.strip()\n",
    "    answer = a_match.group(1).strip() if a_match else \"\"\n",
    "    return question, answer\n",
    "\n",
    "df_full[[\"question\", \"answer\"]] = df_full[\"text\"].apply(lambda t: pd.Series(split_qa(t)))\n",
    "df_full = df_full[(df_full[\"question\"].str.len() > 0) & (df_full[\"answer\"].str.len() > 0)]\n",
    "df_full.head(2)[[\"question\", \"answer\", \"source\"]]\n"
   ]
  },

    "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",

    "# Full dataset split: ~9,150 train / 600 val / 750 test, stratified by source\n",
    "train_val_df, test_df = train_test_split(\n",
    "    df_full, test_size=750, stratify=df_full[\"source\"], random_state=SEED\n",
    ")\n",
    "train_df, val_df = train_test_split(\n",
    "    train_val_df, test_size=600, stratify=train_val_df[\"source\"], random_state=SEED\n",
    ")\n",
    "train_df = train_df.reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "val_df   = val_df.reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "test_df  = test_df.reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Train:\", train_df.shape, \"\\n\", train_df[\"source\"].value_counts())\n",
    "print(\"\\nVal:\", val_df.shape, \"\\n\", val_df[\"source\"].value_counts())\n",
    "print(\"\\nTest:\", test_df.shape, \"\\n\", test_df[\"source\"].value_counts())"
   ]

    "### Instruction Format"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-22T16:55:54.89843Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-22T16:55:54.898024Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-22T16:55:54.902866Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-22T16:55:54.902131Z",
     "shell.execute_reply.started": "2026-08-22T16:55:54.89839Z"
    },
    "trusted": true
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "ALPACA_PROMPT = \"\"\"Below is a medical question. Write a response that appropriately answers it.\n",
    "\n",
    "### Question:\n",
    "{}\n",
    "\n",
    "### Answer:\n",
    "{}\"\"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "def formatting_func(example, tokenizer, include_answer=True):\n",
    "    q, a = example[\"question\"], example[\"answer\"] if include_answer else \"\"\n",
    "    text = ALPACA_PROMPT.format(q, a)\n",
    "    if include_answer:\n",
    "        text += tokenizer.eos_token\n",
    "    return text\n"
   ]
  },

   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from unsloth import FastLanguageModel\n",
    "\n",
    "MODEL_NAME = \"BioMistral/BioMistral-7B\"  # not pre-quantized by Unsloth -> downloads fp16 (~15GB) then quantizes on the fly\n",
    "MAX_SEQ_LENGTH = 1024   # reduced from 1024 -- 7B needs more headroom than the 3B model on a T4\n",
    "DTYPE = None       # auto-detect (bf16 on T4-supporting hardware, fp16 otherwise)\n",
    "LOAD_IN_4BIT = True\n",
    "\n",
    "model, tokenizer = FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(\n",
    "    model_name=MODEL_NAME,\n",
    "    max_seq_length=MAX_SEQ_LENGTH,\n",
    "    dtype=DTYPE,\n",
    "    load_in_4bit=LOAD_IN_4BIT,\n",
    "    use_safetensors=False\n",
    ")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-22T16:57:25.944964Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-22T16:57:25.944539Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-22T16:57:25.949291Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-22T16:57:25.948577Z",
     "shell.execute_reply.started": "2026-08-22T16:57:25.944892Z"
    },
    "trusted": true
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "tokenizer.model_max_length = MAX_SEQ_LENGTH"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Apply QLORA "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-22T16:57:25.950758Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-22T16:57:25.950245Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-22T16:57:30.804506Z",

     "shell.execute_reply.started": "2026-08-22T16:57:25.950597Z"
    },
    "trusted": true
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "model = FastLanguageModel.get_peft_model(\n",
    "    model,\n",
    "    r=16,\n",
    "    target_modules=[\"q_proj\", \"k_proj\", \"v_proj\", \"o_proj\",\n",
    "                     \"gate_proj\", \"up_proj\", \"down_proj\"],\n",
    "    lora_alpha=16,\n",
    "    lora_dropout=0,       # 0 is optimized in Unsloth\n",
    "    bias=\"none\",\n",
    "    use_gradient_checkpointing=\"unsloth\",\n",
    "    random_state=SEED,\n",
    ")\n",
    "model.print_trainable_parameters()\n"
   ]
  },
```
